overview_description.description:
Feather provides furniture and home decor rental service

The company helps city dwellers to furnish their homes without spending a fortune or hurting the planet in the process. Members of Feather have access to high-quality furniture at a low monthly price with the option to add, swap, buy, or return when life or tastes change. Furniture is delivered and assembled for free within a week. Feather’s circular approach reduces the environmental impact that furniture waste has on the planet by keeping furniture in homes and out of landfills.

about_short_description.short_description: Feather is an online furniture rental startup that designs and manufactures all pieces of furniture and home decor available for rent.

product.name: Feather Furniture Subscription
product.description: A monthly service for renting furniture, select décor, and televisions for terms of four to twelve months, with delivery, assembly, item swaps, and return options.

product.name: Rent-to-Own
product.description: A rental option that applies monthly payments toward the retail price of selected furniture, allowing customers to buy items during or near the end of a subscription.

product.name: Upfront Furniture and Décor Purchase
product.description: A direct-purchase option for Feather furniture, select décor, and televisions delivered in new or like-new condition, with return and exchange policies.

product.name: Furniture Delivery and Assembly
product.description: An in-home logistics service that delivers furniture, assembles it in the customer’s chosen rooms, places it, and removes packaging.

product.name: Feather for Business
product.description: Business furnishing offerings for multifamily providers, residential real estate agents, interior decorators and stagers, commercial offices, employers, and relocation programs.

product.name: Virtual Design Help
product.description: An online questionnaire-based service that generates a suggested bedroom or living room design based on a customer’s answers.
